dispositions.reject: an out-of-contract value refuses the whole checkpoint
dispositions.clamp: an out-of-range value is pulled into range or truncated
dispositions.drop: an out-of-contract value removes the field, never fails the write
dispositions.pass: stored as written; consumers must tolerate any shape
dispositions.strip: a model-emitted value is discarded at the serialize boundary; the persisted value is always code-derived

owners.model: extracted content, policed by the validator and normalizers
owners.code: stamped by daimon's own write pipeline

columns.type: the JSON type the producer writes when it writes the field
columns.optional: whether a stored checkpoint may lack the field
columns.nullable: whether an explicit null is tolerated where the field is present; false on a reject row means an explicit null is rejected like any other out-of-contract value
columns.constraints: see constraint_semantics; keys not listed there are documentation for consumers, not runtime checks

constraint_semantics.validate: the structural check the runtime validator performs on this envelope field: presence, object, item-required, item-list-required (absence rejects), item-list-optional (absence = empty list)
constraint_semantics.enum: closed set of accepted values; anything else rejects with reject_reason
constraint_semantics.required_if_eq: [field, value]: this field must be a non-empty string ONLY when the named sibling field equals the value; otherwise it is unconstrained and any shape passes (so a reject disposition with this key is conditional, not unconditional)
constraint_semantics.object_keys: sub-keys that must each be a non-empty string when the field is present and non-null; a non-object rejects, a missing/empty sub-key rejects with reject_reason_missing
constraint_semantics.reject_reason: the exact reason string the validator returns when this row rejects
constraint_semantics.reject_reason_missing: the reason string when a required sub-key is absent or empty
constraint_semantics.min: inclusive lower clamp bound for in-type integers; non-integers (booleans included) drop the field
constraint_semantics.max: inclusive upper clamp bound for in-type integers
constraint_semantics.strip_whitespace: leading/trailing whitespace is removed before storing
constraint_semantics.max_chars: the stored string is truncated to this many characters
constraint_semantics.stripped_at_serialize: a model-emitted value for this field is discarded at the serialize boundary; the persisted value is always code-derived
constraint_semantics.pattern: regex the code-stamped value matches (documentation, not a runtime check)
constraint_semantics.format: timestamp format of the code-stamped value (documentation)
